_note: Behavioral evals for the first turn. layers is standalone: no engine, no progress files.

evals.name: batched-html-first-principles
evals.expected_output: Publishes an HTML artifact in the notebook style containing only Layers 0-2. Layer 1 names concrete constraints (latency, caching/TTL, single point of failure) rather than a kid-level analogy. Chat ends with one short question asking the reader to state Layer 1 in their own words, plus a Native English block. Does not dump Layers 3-7 yet.

evals.name: aws-and-scale-layers
evals.expected_output: Produces all seven layers in one artifact. Layer 4 maps to ALB/NLB/GWLB with an SVG architecture diagram and a service-to-trap table (e.g. ALB pre-warming / cross-zone defaults / idle timeout). Layer 5 has an evolution ladder from single ALB to global (Route 53 / Global Accelerator). Layer 6 names the metrics to check (e.g. HTTPCode_ELB_5XX_Count, TargetResponseTime) and a first command. Layer 7 has L4 vs L6 answers inside <details>.

evals.name: routes-k8s-topic
